title: GR4SP, a Generic Recursive Simulation of Socio-technical Systems for Service Provision
description: Agent-based simulation of the Victorian electricity system (Australia), 1998-2019 validation against the historical record. This release is the model version described in the methods article (in preparation): the base case frozen on 20 Nov 2026, the 100-seed validation ensemble, figures and tables (experiments/validation). Earlier scenario and sensitivity outputs are in the separate dataset 10.5281/zenodo.4667996.
